intent: A solid black floating pill navbar for a studio or product site that narrows and drops its wordmark on scroll, with a sliding hover highlight and a full-screen big-type menu on mobile.

layout.header: fixed inset-x-0 top-0, pointer-events-none, padding 12px (20px from sm), centres the pill
layout.pill: w-full, maxWidth 1200px -> 720px when condensed, rounded-full, #111111, padding 8px/16px/8px/8px
groups: logo: 36px cream circle with arch mark + 22px wordmark
pink CTA pill with arrow chip
layout.mobile: below md: links and CTA hidden, Menu button shown; sheet is fixed inset-0, cobalt, pt 112px, links stacked with rules and mono indices, CTA + contact dl + socials pinned to the bottom

motion.hoverPill: shared layoutId inside LayoutGroup(useId), spring 500/40, follows hover and focus, fades out on list leave
motion.condense: past 80px scroll: maxWidth 1200 -> 720, padding 8 -> 6, wordmark width -> 0, shadow on; spring 380/36
motion.menuIcon: two bars 7px apart rotate to +45/-45deg, 0.35s ease [0.2,0.8,0.2,1]; label slides Menu -> Close
motion.sheet: clipPath inset(0 0 100% 0) -> inset(0) 0.6s; links rise from y 100% staggered 60ms from 180ms; footer fades up at 450ms
motion.reducedMotion: instant transitions; sheet fades instead of wiping

responsive.mobile: pill shows logo + Menu button; full-screen sheet with 44-72px links
responsive.md: links and CTA inline; sheet closes itself if the viewport crosses 768px
responsive.lg: links get 20px padding; pill up to 1200px

accessibility: sheet role=dialog aria-modal, focus trapped inside the header, Esc closes and returns focus
wordmark kept as sr-only text when folded
avoid: underline hover effects instead of the sliding pill
a small dropdown list for mobile
gradient fills on the pill or CTA
